_about: What windows/setup.ps1 installs on the helper PC, pinned so a rebuild gets the same. Open WebUI's version is not
here: it is always the one the main PC runs (versions.env), so Open WebUI's data can move between the two PCs.
torch: one build for every Python environment (shared through uv's cache); cu126 is the newest CUDA build that
still has kernels for GTX 10 (Pascal) cards. torchvision and torchaudio must be the releases made with that torch
(a newer torchvision fails on import: 'operator torchvision::nms does not exist').
